process.discoveryMethod: Searched all 577,344 bytes / 15,991 lines of source DJVU text for all vehicle type lines, ground/air/water variants, CL headings, and transportation references, including OCR-split two-column statblocks. Independently rendered and visually swept all 161 physical pages in nine labeled original-PDF contact sheets; performed close readable review of all 18 new source block starts. Verified original PDF SHA against 35-record historical book closure, then matched all inherited keys, names, types, and physical/printed pages directly.
process.printedToPdfMapping: Zero-based PDF index equals printed page; one-based physical PDF page equals printed +1.
sectionCoverage: Chapter IV: Vehicles and Starships, printed pp60-69 (civilian vehicles and nine original spacecraft)
Chapter VI: The Rebel Alliance, pp110-115 (Rebel ground vehicles and spacecraft)
Chapter VII: The Empire, pp131-139 (walker and ground artillery alongside Imperial starfighters/ships)
Chapter VIII: Fringe Factions, pp153-156 (Zann Consortium tank/transport and spacecraft)
Remaining introductory, equipment, chapter narrative, NPC/droid and index pages; full 161-page contact-sheet survey
process.sourceDocumentTextSemantics: Original PDF is entirely scanned and has zero searchable text; original page image is authority. DJVU text is only discovery layer and mixes column orders (particularly printed p135) and misrecognizes roman numerals and CL in several places.
process.exhaustivenessCaveat: Full DJVU text plus visual page-by-page thumbnail sweep, with source high-resolution confirmation of candidates; unusually embedded image-only statblocks may require future review but none surfaced.

identityDecisions.subject: TIE Aggressor and TIE ap-1 Mauler/TIE Crawler on two-column page
identityDecisions.reason: Printed p135 has a starfighter TIE Aggressor already included among historical 35, and two separately headed Huge ground vehicle (tracked) blocks: the Mauler and the Crawler. DJVU OCR interleaves these columns; no duplicate or missing vehicle permitted.

identityDecisions.subject: 9000 Z004 Landspeeder and Air-2 Swoop
identityDecisions.reason: Printed independently side by side with separate CL2 statblocks; Air-2 Swoop is not a cosmetic 9000 Z004 variant.

identityDecisions.subject: Bantha-II alternate enclosed/aquatic/desert/cosmetic skiffs
identityDecisions.reason: Story modifications to one Bantha-II statblock are not separately statted publication vehicle identities.

identityDecisions.subject: MPTL-2a deployment/spotter modifiers
identityDecisions.reason: Immobile and mobile firing modes are one tracked launcher's rules, not separate vehicle identities.

identityDecisions.subject: TIE ap-1 Mauler and TIE Crawler
identityDecisions.reason: Both have independent full type lines, CL7 and CL6 and differing printed profiles.

identityDecisions.subject: Lancet Aerial Artillery
identityDecisions.reason: Printed type line is simply 'Gargantuan air vehicle', not '(airspeeder)'; the DJVU extract drops CL12 from the header.

identityDecisions.subject: Rebel speeders, walker variations and shipboard craft mentioned in story and equipment
identityDecisions.reason: Mentions of named vehicles, carried craft quantities, upgrades or variants without a new standalone printed statblock are not additional source publication claims.

identityDecisions.subject: LV-38 Spotter/Probe Droid
identityDecisions.reason: Adjacent CL3 fourth-degree droid statblock has independent droid type, not a ground or aerial vehicle.

identityDecisions.subject: Dark Trooper Phase I/II/III
identityDecisions.reason: Dark troopers have character/droid statistics, even when bulky or vehicle-like in illustration; not vehicle-type statblocks.

identityDecisions.subject: Weaponry, modifications, vehicles from Core and other books
identityDecisions.reason: No separately printed SWSE Saga vehicle-statblock identity can be inferred from cross-references, vehicle equipment or optional modifications.
